newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.

text.p: * Romania's Foreign Ministry hails introduction of a bill in the U.S. Congress urging NATO admission for Romania, and the Baltics as soon as they meet membership requirements.
* Romanian government and local World Bank officials discussed future World Bank programmes in Romania.
* Romania's King Michael arrived in Timisoara for a private visit which coincides with Orthodox Easter celebrations.
* Hungary's ambassador to Romania has talks with local government authorithies on opening a Hungarian consulate in Transylvania's main city of Cluj.
